units.source_text: 迄今我并非全未想过要把老师杀掉，

en.t: Until now, it was not that I had never thought of killing the teacher,

units.source_text: 可是我很快就意识到这样做是无济于事。

en.t: but I soon realized that doing so would be of no use.

units.source_text: 因为我知道即使把老师杀掉，

en.t: Because I knew that even if I killed the teacher,

units.source_text: 他的和尚头和他的无力的罪恶还是会源源不断地、不计其数地从黑暗的地平线上涌现出来。

en.t: his monk's head and his powerless evil would still keep emerging endlessly and countless times from the dark horizon.
